## Load in Data

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(knitr)
library(survival)
library(mlogit)
everglades <- read_dta("LCM_4classes_data.dta")

set.seed(420)
```

## Fit the Conditional Logit Model

```{r}

everglades <- everglades |>
  mutate(
    black = as.integer(race == 2),
    other_race = as.integer(!race %in% c(1, 2)),
    hispanic = spanish
  )

attrs <- c(
  "bird10e2", "bird50e2", "bird75e2",
  "gator10e2", "gator50e2", "gator75e2",
  "snail10e2", "snail50e2", "snail75e2",
  "trout10e2", "trout50e2", "trout75e2",
  "water10e2", "water50e2", "water75e2"
)
```

```{r}
table(everglades$bird10e2, everglades$cdum)

table(everglades$bird10e1, everglades$cdum)

# this confirms that option c is coded as a negative, we need to recode this to fit the model
```

```{r}
recode_everglades <- everglades |>
  mutate(across(
    matches("^(bird|gator|snail|trout|water)(10|50|75)e2$"),
    ~ as.integer(.x == 1),
    .names = "{sub('e2$', '', .col)}"
  ))

table(everglades$gator10e2, everglades$option)

with(everglades, table(cdum,option))
```

```{r}
everglades_mlogit <- mlogit.data(
  data    = recode_everglades,
  choice  = "choice",
  shape   = "long",
  chid.var = "groupid",
  alt.var  = "option",
  id.var   = "respondentid"
)


clogit_model <- mlogit(
  choice ~ cdum +
    bird10 + bird50 + bird75 +
    gator10 + gator50 + gator75 +
    snail10 + snail50 + snail75 +
    trout10 + trout50 + trout75 +
    water10 + water50 + water75 +
    cost | 0,
  data = everglades_mlogit
)
summary(clogit_model)
```

Nicely Output Results

```{r}
s  <- summary(clogit_model)
ct <- s$CoefTable
b_cost <- coef(clogit_model)["cost"]

b <- coef(clogit_model)
attrs <- setdiff(names(b), c("cdum", "cost"))
round(-b[attrs] / b["cost"], 2)

# Paper's significance star usage: *** 1%, ** 5%, * 10%
stars <- function(p) case_when(p < 0.01 ~ "***",
                               p < 0.05 ~ "**",
                               p < 0.10 ~ "*",
                               TRUE     ~ "")

wtp_table <- tibble(
  Variable    = rownames(ct),
  Coefficient = paste0(formatC(ct[, "Estimate"], format = "f", digits = 3),
                       stars(ct[, "Pr(>|z|)"])),
  `Std. Error` = formatC(ct[, "Std. Error"], format = "f", digits = 3),
  WTP = ifelse(Variable %in% c("cdum", "cost"),
               "",
               paste0("$", formatC(-ct[, "Estimate"] / b_cost,
                                   format = "f", digits = 2)))
) |>
  mutate(Variable = recode(Variable, cdum = "optout"))

# summary rows
ll     <- as.numeric(logLik(clogit_model))
n_rows <- nrow(everglades_mlogit)
n_ch   <- n_rows / 3                      # choice occasions (12,599)
ll0    <- n_ch * log(1/3)                 # null model: equal shares
lr     <- 2 * (ll - ll0)
df     <- length(coef(clogit_model))     # 17, as in the paper
pval   <- pchisq(lr, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)
r2     <- 1 - ll / ll0                    

stat_rows <- tibble(
  Variable     = c("Log Likelihood", "N", paste0("LR chi2(", df, ")"),
                   "Prob>chi2", "Pseudo R2"),
  Coefficient  = c(formatC(ll,   format = "f", digits = 3, big.mark = ","),
                   formatC(n_rows, format = "d", big.mark = ","),
                   formatC(lr,   format = "f", digits = 2, big.mark = ","),
                   formatC(pval, format = "f", digits = 4),
                   formatC(r2,   format = "f", digits = 4)),
  `Std. Error` = "",
  WTP          = ""
)

final_table <- bind_rows(wtp_table, stat_rows)
knitr::kable(final_table, align = c("l", "r", "r", "r"))

```

## Random Parameter Logit Model in the WTP space

needs a different package

``` R
{r}
#| eval: false
b   <- coef(rpl)
lam <- exp(b["negcost"])                      # median cost coefficient (~0.0125)

# names and order that logitr expects (works even from the failed fit)
nm <- names(coef(wtp_fit))

sv <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(nm)), nm)
sv[pars]                  <- b[pars] / lam              # WTP means
sv["scalePar"]            <- b["negcost"]               # log-mean of the scale
sv["sd_scalePar"]         <- abs(b["sd.negcost"])
sv[paste0("sd_", pars)]   <- abs(b[paste0("sd.", pars)]) / lam

anyNA(sv)   # should be FALSE; if TRUE, compare names(sv) with nm

# needs a 0/1 outcome column and a sequential choice-occasion ID, with rows grouped by occasion
```

``` R
{r}
#| eval: false
#test a few draws
library(logitr)
wtp_fit2 <- logitr(
  data = wtp_data, outcome = "choice", obsID = "obsID", panelID = "respondentid",
  pars = pars, scalePar = "cost",
  randPars = setNames(rep("n", length(pars)), pars), randScale = "ln",
  startVals = sv, numMultiStarts = 1,
  drawType = "halton", numDraws = 500
)
summary(wtp_fit2)
logLik(wtp_fit2) # paper: -10,758.264
```

## Latent Class Model

``` R
{r}
#| eval: false
library(gmnl)

f_sel <- as.formula(paste("choice ~ cdum +", paste(attrs, collapse = " + "),
                          "+ cost | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1"))

fit_q <- lapply(2:6, function(q)
  gmnl(f_sel, data = everglades_mlogit2, model = "lc", Q = q, panel = TRUE,
       method = "bfgs", iterlim = 500))

ic <- function(m, n = 2100) {
  ll <- as.numeric(logLik(m)); k <- attr(logLik(m), "df")
  c(LL = ll, k = k, BIC = -2*ll + k*log(n), CAIC = -2*ll + k*(log(n) + 1))
}
do.call(rbind, lapply(fit_q, ic))
```

``` R
{r}
#| eval: false
covs <- c("female","black","other_race","hispanic","age","college",
          "income","politics","nep","nocost","nogovt","nopay")

f_lc <- as.formula(paste(
  "choice ~ cdum +", paste(attrs, collapse = " + "), "+ cost | 0 | 0 | 0 |",
  paste(covs, collapse = " + ")))

lc4 <- gmnl(f_lc, data = everglades_mlogit2, model = "lc", Q = 4,
            panel = TRUE, method = "bfgs", iterlim = 1000)
summary(lc4)
```
